svg.title: Foundry hosted agent: ship an image, run the agent
svg.desc: You build a container image bundling your code and skills, push it to Azure Container Registry, and Foundry runs it as a hosted agent with a dedicated microVM per session, an agent identity, an endpoint, and telemetry. Tools live behind a single versioned MCP toolbox endpoint, and the agent can be invoked from a SOAR playbook, a schedule, or an API call.
svg.text: You ship the image. Foundry runs the agent.
Code and skills can bake into the artifact · tools live behind one versioned MCP toolbox · invoke through a protected endpoint.
managed endpoint · agent identity · versions · telemetry

g.text: Web Search · AI Search · Code · Files · MCP · A2A

svg.text: token cost stays flat as the toolbox grows
does nothing until you promote it.
Same muscle memory as containers — immutable artifacts · controlled releases · scale-to-zero · one active agent version.
